thread:
Alex: Quick async standup — gateway / routing / auth / rate limits
What I did: landed the routing policy change to prefer region-local pods and ran a short canary on staging.
Blockers: intermittent 429s hitting /v1/generate during bursts, unsure if it's client backpressure or gw throttle.
Today: roll policy to 20% in staging, dig into 429 traces, coordinate with infra for metrics retention.

Priya: Re: 429s — saw the same spike in metrics. Traced it to per-route token-bucket filling up when requests fan out to fallback model. Working on a fix: bump per-route capacity + client-side short backoff.
PR: https://git.internal/redwood/gateway/pulls/782
Can folks review? @Alex @Jordan

Jordan: Canary metrics: latency stable but error% spiked to ~2.7% around 15:02. Fallback routing to the v2 model increased fanout which amplified the burst. I muted automatic fallback for the canary to isolate.

Dan: Quick config suggestion to reduce immediate 429 risk — increase route burst capacity. Example: 
```
route:
  rate_limit:
    unit: requests
    capacity: 200
    burst: 50
```
If y'all agree I can push to canary.

Maya: Added synthetic traces to reproduce the spike: https://perf/redwood/gateway/traces/1933
Also noticed auth token refreshes briefly returning 503 from auth-service during the window (~30s). Could be related.

Alex: Thanks — @Dan please go ahead and push the burst change to canary. @Priya please add the client retry/backoff change (short, jittered). If both look stable we'll promote to 40% tomorrow AM. I'm still waiting on infra perms to pull full retention logs — pinged @ops.

CI-bot: deploy-bot: queued deploy to canary for gateway @commit 1a2b3c. staging rollout start: 1933334477. :rocket:

Priya: Will open client PR today, target EOD.

Jordan: I'll monitor traces and add a temporary alert for >1% increase in error% during bursts.

Alex: Blocker update: still waiting on metrics retention permission from infra, otherwise unblocked for the day. Pinged ops and will follow up in the afternoon.

Dan: Noted, pushing config now to canary. Will post results shortly.

Maya: If the auth 503s persist, I can add a short health-check to the token refresh path to fallback more gracefully.

Alex: Great, thanks everyone.
